dogecoin.text:
Wow, go #dogecoin! 🐕🚀🌕

Yes, it was created as a meme joke but even years ago it was the crypto of donations. 

As it gains popularity I hope it's used for donations to animal shelters & other good deeds. 

That's how it can in the long run last & have a utility beyond hedging
@RichardJAcosta @predederva @SenWarren Yeah, even dogecoin, despite it making new coins per day (it was a fork of litecoin) will eventually have less new circulation than the US dollar does.
